problem_index.problem: Combat feels floaty, lacks impact or punch
problem_index.recommendation: Add hitstop freeze frames (2-4 frames), knockback displacement, audio impact, camera shake.

problem_index.problem: Player drops out after Day 1 (Low D1/D7 retention)
problem_index.recommendation: Shorten tutorial under 90s, grant early win within 2 minutes, clarify core loop before complexity.

problem_index.problem: How to design multi-phase Boss fights
problem_index.section: Level 13: Now You're Playing with Power / The Big Boss
problem_index.recommendation: 3-phase structure: Phase 1 introduce moves, Phase 2 combine with environmental hazards, Phase 3 desperate frenzy mode.

problem_index.problem: How to write a 1-page GDD to pitch to executives or investors
problem_index.recommendation: Use 5 sections: Hook, Core Pillars (3 max), Core Loop, Target Audience, Visual Style.

problem_index.problem: Camera clipping through walls or awkward 3D angles
problem_index.section: Level 7: The Three C's - Part 3: Camera
problem_index.recommendation: Implement smart pitch elevation near walls and object dither/fade transparency when occluding character.

problem_index.problem: Players feel game is boring after mastering it
problem_index.section: Chapter 2: How the Brain Works & Chapter 7: The Problem with Learning
problem_index.recommendation: Introduce emergent systems, asymmetric player roles, or new mechanics that shift the possibility space.

problem_index.problem: How to conduct an objective playtest without biasing players
problem_index.recommendation: Silence is golden: watch where players get stuck without speaking; observe actions, do not trust verbal explanations.
